**席位意见:** ACCEPT at head `0a6f40c6f902ccbb0ccea78f80f3abe9dd909534` · 2026-11-10T13:29Z. 中文界面里审计日志的时间列与表格单元格改用同一套时钟(12 小时制、精确到秒、按工作区声明的时区显示);设置页 6 条中文提示的半角冒号、逗号改为全角。英文显示逐字不变;德文审计日志由 24 小时制改为 12 小时制,是本席裁定 (8)B 的刻意结果。#32158 其余条目已拆到 #32218(服务端/平台对象)与 #32219(示例应用),语言名称一条留在 #32158 等 #32021。纯前端,不改协议,非受管面;CI 全绿后由本席入队。

## 席位核对

- **Shape:** 7 files, +277 −10, `Part of #32158`. `@object-ui/core` gains `formatDateTimeStamp` (the compact face's numeric date, `hour12: true`, the declared display zone via `zoneFor`/`inZone`, to the second); `AuditLogPage` draws its timestamp column through it in place of a bare `toLocaleString(locale)`; six `console.settingsView` zh-Hans values take full-width `：`/`，` in place, no key added, removed or moved. One changeset, `patch` on core, i18n, console.
- **Rulings honoured:** (8) B, one shared helper, en unchanged, de pin moves to 12-hour; (7b) the six values only; (1) the object-extension label is the showcase's authored override, by design (ADR-0029 D9.2a). Step 0 split: #32218, #32219 filed by this seat; the language-name item stays on #32158 behind #32021 (`FirstRunChecklist.tsx` held by `domain:ui#2`).
- **Premise measured:** each fix reproduced on `origin/main` sources first: settings 5 failed of 15, audit 3 failed of 15; branch 34/34.
- **Deliberate assertion change:** `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` de-DE audit pin `4.3.2020, 15:30:00` → `4.3.2020, 3:30:00 PM`, declared in the body. Accepted under ruling (8) B.
- **Design note:** a separate export rather than a new `formatDateTime` `style` value, because an authored field `format` reaches `style` through `temporalCellText`; a new value there would be a new metadata spelling. Agreed.
- **Deviations:** (a) the first commit `wip: zh-CN settings page punctuation` lacks the trailer pair; `check-commit-card-trailers` passes and history was not rewritten. (b) the helper shape above. (c) console type-check not run locally (needs the ui build closure); core type-check exit 0, and remote Type Check covers it. (d) the PR body was edited once after `pr_create` by the dev thread at this seat's explicit request (split-card numbers), through the relay `issue_patch`, read-back identical 7714 B, signed under this seat.
- **Gates:** `/mnt/project-files/card-32158/gates-0a6f40c6.txt` (36 derived + sdui-manifest, spec-symbols, commit-card-trailers, ui scripts suite, new-line-citations: all exit 0). Remote checks were in progress at review; landing waits for every check green.
- **Contract faces:** none of the four, so CI plus this seat read is the review of record. No English text added, so the `i18n-locale-en` ceiling (#32225) is untouched. Changeset prose checked against the diff.
- **Landing:** non-governed, under 3,000 lines: queue once every check is green.

## 席位核对 (delta)

- **Delta since `0a6f40c6`:** one commit, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hant.ts` +6 −6, regenerated by `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant` from the edited zh-Hans source: the same six `console.settingsView` values take `：`/`，`. Seat read the diff line by line; no other file moved.
- **Why:** `Test UI (2/16)` (job 129859368587) failed `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/zh-hant-generated.test.ts`: zh-Hant is generated from zh-Hans and was stale. This was the PR's own failure, now fixed; local re-run 9/9.
- **Body:** updated through the relay `issue_patch`, read-back identical 8043 B (deviation (d) of the first ACCEPT applies again).
- **Gates:** `/mnt/project-files/card-32158/gates-b24d94f5.txt`. Remote checks in progress at review; landing waits for every check green.
- Everything else in 6768631012 stands: shape, rulings (8) B and (7b), deviations (a)–(d), contract faces none, non-governed, under 3,000 lines.
